an3.142:1.1: tayo ca bhikkhave, bhadre assājānīye desessāmi tayo ca bhadre purisājānīye.
an3.142:2.1: katame ca bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā assājānīyā?
an3.142:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ekacco bhadro assājānīyo javasampanno ca hoti, (…pe… na ārohapariṇāhasampanno hoti …pe… idha bhikkhave ekacco bhadro assājānīyo
an3.142:2.3: javasampanno ca hoti.) vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an3.142:2.4: ime kho, bhikkhave tayo bhadrā assājānīyā.
an3.142:3.1: katame ca bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā purisājānīyā (…pe…)
an3.142:3.3: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca. (…pe…)
an3.142:4.2: javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an3.142:4.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.142:4.5: abhidhamme kho pana abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeti, no saṃsādeti.
an3.142:4.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhadro purisājānīyo javasampanno ca hoti vaṇṇasampanno ca ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an3.142:4.10: ime kho bhikkhave, tayo bhadrā purisājānīyāti.
